title: Article 13 — Laws inconsistent with fundamental rights

content.heading: Laws inconsistent with or in derogation of the fundamental rights
content.text: All laws in force immediately before commencement, so far as inconsistent with this Part, shall to the extent of inconsistency be void. The State shall not make any law which takes away or abridges the rights conferred by this Part. Law includes ordinance, order, bye-law, rule, regulation, notification, custom or usage.
